source_checks.finding: Amendment Article 2 fixes July 17 for land/maritime reopening; not a train-service reopening.

Original decree 2020-080 Article 18 maintains national land and maritime passenger closure and exempts goods. The retained web-batch-08 evidence explicitly displays this decree URL and Articles 18–19; this entry corrects a duplicated amendment URL, without changing the geography judgment.
Decree065 Article 7 national land closure for finite ordered interval.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Distinct Djibouti national land-passenger decree phases and a separate Ethiopia–Djibouti passenger railway suspension. Road controls must not locate the railway phase. Current phase only: National land-border closure ordered in decree 2020-065 of March 24

date_scope_check.qualification_retained:
H11-R1: Decree 2020-065 took immediate effect on March 24. Article 7 states two weeks and Article 9 fifteen days, so the existing April 6–8 counting bounds remain scheduled interpretations, not observed reopening. The ambassador’s March 18 retrospective is earlier reported closure, not the date of this instrument.

H11-C7P1: Decree 2020-074, signed April 15, expressly applies for fifteen days from April 9. This supports a scheduled April 23–24 expiry bound depending on day counting; it does not supply an actual reopening. Decree 2020-078, dated April 30, extends the measures until May 8. The intervening documentary gap is neither proof of reopening nor a fully recovered legal chronology.

H11-C7P2: The April 30–May 8 extension remains an ordered window. H11-R2: Decree 2020-080 maintains the land-passenger closure from May 10; decree 2020-145 substitutes July 17 for the previously scheduled September 1 reopening. Goods are exempt and admitted passengers face testing. These legal dates do not establish identical operation or counterpart permission at every crossing.

REC50-R37-H11-P1: The transport ministry’s March 18 notice announces passenger-train suspension from March 20, with cargo unaffected. The operator reports actual passenger-service resumption on January 27, 2021 after ten months of suspension. This establishes a sustained rail restriction exceeding 24 hours without an exact independently timed first non-operating day. July 2020 land-policy reopening is not the rail endpoint. The operator article is dated February 20, 2021, despite the migrated URL containing 2025.
